services.name: tandem jumps
services.desc: Skydiving is a truly life-changing experience, and you’ve picked one of the most spectacular places on the planet to do it! Skydive Key West is the premier destination for tandem skydiving South Florida and the Florida Keys. Tandem skydiving means you’ll be attached to one of our certified instructors with a special harness and parachute system designed for two for the entirety of your skydive - in the plane and in the sky, until you’re both safely on the ground. A tandem skydive is the ideal way to experience the thrill of skydiving for the first time. From the moment you enter our doors, you’ll see why we’re consistently rated one of the top 10 places in the world to skydive. Each member

includes: Scenic flight above the Florida Keys

blurb: Guests receive thorough training, take a scenic flight above turquoise waters, and perform a tandem skydive with expert instructors. The experience includes freefall and parachute descent with breathtaking views of the Florida Keys. The operation has over 30 years of experience and a strong safety record.
